core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rahil is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Departure, journey”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rahil corresponds to the Arabic form رَحِيل (Arabic root ر ح ل (r-ḥ-l); رَحِيل (Raḥīl)). Its core sense is rahil; departure, journey. Rahil is Arabic رَحِيل (Raḥīl) 'departure, journey', from the root ر ح ل (r-ḥ-l). The source gloss 'Traveler, Nomad' is broadly consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly male. Same name as raheel.
